description: Restructure VayuLokLive into the FINAL TARGET two-column desktop workspace. LEFT = selected-place card (photo + lime number pill + name + address + metadata/attributes/description + the existing VayuLok AQI/PM2.5 environmental RESULT system when a layer is active). RIGHT = map only, carrying the search bar + AQI|PM2.5 selector + single marker + Google attribution. Remove the on-map Expand/Collapse control + keyboard-expand, the floating photo gallery/rail, the photo-count overlay pill (relocated into the left card), the on-map place-information remnants, and extra map controls. Resolve the heatmap conflict: KEEP meaningful scientific value variation at ~30% opacity (do NOT flatten to one lime); lime #d1f470 applies to the SELECTOR chrome only. All edits are in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx; tests updated in src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx. The hero in src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx MUST stay unchanged.
review_refinements: Review 2026-10-04-035200 (APPROVED): addressed issue 1 (left-card metadata/attributes/description/supporting-info) and issue 2 (PM2.5 'Current status' label). Issue 3 (tile URL carries key in query string) is explicitly no-action-required (pre-existing, unchanged by this cycle).

ISSUE 1 FIX - left-card metadata/attributes/description/supporting-info: Extended PlaceState with optional honest fields (primaryType, types, rating, userRatingCount, websiteURI, openNow, summary). Added PLACE_META_FIELDS = ['types','primaryTypeDisplayName','rating','userRatingCount','websiteURI','regularOpeningHours','editorialSummary'] (all real Places JS API fields) and appended them to the EXISTING keyed fetchFields on BOTH the search/select (choose) path AND the map-click reverse-geocode Place path - never fetched unconditionally, so honest degradation (no key => no fetch) is intact. metaFromGooglePlace() maps each datum ONLY when genuinely present (Number.isFinite for rating/count, typeof-string truthy for website/summary, typeof-boolean for openNow); absent fields stay undefined and their line does not render. humanisePlaceType() normalises snake_case type tokens to Title Case. In the left place card (inline in the return tree) added, between address and the layer-gated result, a .vl-live-place-meta block: a .vl-live-place-facts <dl> (Category = primaryType, Rating = N.N (count reviews)), a .vl-live-place-attrs checklist (lime #1a3a2a check SVG) with honest flags (Open now/Closed now, Official website listed) + human-readable secondary types, a .vl-live-place-desc paragraph from editorialSummary, and .vl-live-place-support bullets composed from already-fetched live context (AQI band word, weather condition, coordinates) gated on liveActive so the keyless card stays name+address only. New CSS added to the <style jsx> block with the vl-live- prefix using existing tokens (hairline #e5e7eb, muted ink, 14px radii, --green). NO RED. Never shows a placeholder or invented fact.

ISSUE 2 FIX - PM2.5 'Current status' label: Added statusWord(sev) deriving a plain-English status from the EXISTING severity band (good->Clean, sat->Acceptable, mod->Elevated, poor->High, worst->Hazardous) - not a new scale. In the layer==='PM25' result block (inline) added a .vl-live-status-label 'Current status' line + .vl-live-status-word with the derived word (e.g. AQI 168 -> Moderate -> 'Elevated', matching the mockup). No-red styling consistent with the existing result ladder.

VERIFICATION: npm run typecheck clean; npm run lint 0 errors / 203 pre-existing warnings (base-vs-working lint-warning count identical => zero new warnings from this change); npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx 19/19 pass (was 17, +2 new: a metadata-present test that stubs a Place carrying the new fields and asserts Category/Rating/attributes/description render in .vl-live-left and that the extra fields were requested on the keyed path, and a metadata-absent test asserting .vl-live-place-facts/.vl-live-place-attrs/.vl-live-place-desc do NOT render when Google returns none); the existing layer-swap test extended to assert the PM2.5 block shows 'Current status' + status word 'Elevated'; req-06 attribution guard and honest-degradation (no-key => no fetch) tests remain green. Full npm run test 908 passed / 3 pre-existing skips / 0 fail (was 906). git diff --stat src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx empty (hero unchanged). No red hex, no .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google] selectors introduced. Not pushed.

OUT OF SCOPE (flagged for separate triage, NOT actioned here): a live-steering message raised (a) a geocoding-library initialization concern (Geocoder sourced from the legacy/maps namespace rather than an explicit importLibrary('geocoding')), and (b) that the heatmap tests prove ImageMapType/URL construction but not live tile render. Both are independent of the APPROVED review's refinement issues and were not changed; the review verdict was APPROVED and these would be a new scope. Note the heatmap live-tile render cannot be verified in-sandbox anyway because the browser Maps key is referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/*.
steps: LAYOUT: Keep ONE .vl-live-grid with two columns. LEFT column (.vl-live-left) must now LEAD with the selected-place card: a photo block, then the lime number pill, then PLACE NAME, full formatted address, place metadata, attribute checklist, description, and supporting info. When `layer` is non-null, the existing VayuLok air-quality RESULT content (AQI value/category/dominant pollutant/pollutant values/severity/health guidance and the existing AQI scale/result visual system already in this component) renders INSIDE the left card. RIGHT column (.vl-live-right / .vl-live-map-sticky / .vl-live-map-stage) is MAP ONLY. Keep ALL left-card and right-map markup INLINE in the component return tree (styled-jsx scope gotcha: lifting markup into a variable/child silently drops styles). Match homepage design language (tokens on .vl-live: --lime #d1f470, --green #1a3a2a, panel radius 14px per design-tokens.md, hairline #e5e7eb, no resting shadows). Stack sensibly on mobile (left above right, or map first then card - pick the mobile order that keeps the search usable; document the choice).

RELOCATE PHOTO + PILL INTO LEFT CARD: Move the place photo and the `[referee SVG] [bare number]` lime pill (e.g. '8', NOT '8 photos') out of the map overlay and into the top of the left card. Pill background must be exactly site lime #d1f470 with #1a3a2a content (reuse the existing .vl-live-photo-count SVG+number markup; keep it number-only per req 01). Remove the floating .vl-live-map-photos overlay, its page/tabs rail, and the photo-count-on-map placement from the RIGHT column. CRITICAL: the Google Place Photo author-attribution figcaption (.vl-live-photo-credit with its contributor <a href> link) MUST still render with the photo in its new left-card location - the req-06 attribution guard test depends on it. Keep the photo cells and pill on the exact same lime as the pill where feasible (the steer noted photo cells used --lime-solid #f5fde0 not the exact pill lime; align them so photo + pill share the exact #d1f470 lime background per req 01's 'same lime').

STRIP THE MAP (right column) of everything the spec lists under 'What is NOT on the map': remove the Expand-map/Collapse-map <button> (.vl-live-map-expand) and the mapExpanded state + is-expanded stage sizing + the keyboard-expand control; remove the floating photo gallery (done above); remove the photo-count pill overlay (done above); remove any on-map place-information card remnants; remove extra drag/zoom/keyboard map UI and extra map controls. KEEP basic usable map pan via gestureHandling:'greedy'. The only things remaining visually on the RIGHT are: the SEARCH BAR, the AQI|PM2.5 selector, the MAP, the single SELECTED MARKER, and the GOOGLE ATTRIBUTION. Keep the map fallback (honest degradation) and the map-ready reveal logic. Remove now-dead CSS for removed elements (.vl-live-map-expand, is-expanded, photo overlay rules) per the file's 'unused rules are deleted' convention.

SEARCH stays on the RIGHT over the map (keep the existing India autocomplete: AutocompleteSuggestion.fetchAutocompleteSuggestions, per-session token, includedRegionCodes:['in'], region:'in', INDIA_BOUNDS). On select -> geocode/resolve -> update BOTH columns for the SAME place: the left card photo/name/address/metadata AND the map recenter + single marker. The existing setPlace + recenter effect + choose() flow already drives both; ensure the left card reads from the same `place`/`previewPlace` state so one selection updates both sides.

AQI|PM2.5 SELECTOR styling: keep it on the RIGHT over the map. Fill the ACTIVE tab with the EXACT site lime #d1f470 and use #1a3a2a for its text/boundary; show a clear active state (active tab highlighted) matching the mockups. Replace any approximate translucent-lime active styling with the exact #d1f470. Selecting AQI shows the AQI result block in the LEFT card AND turns on the AQI heatmap; selecting PM2.5 shows the PM2.5-focused result block AND the PM2.5 heatmap. Reuse the EXISTING air-quality result/visual markup+styles already in this component (relocate/reuse them in the left card; do not invent a new result system).

HEATMAP CONFLICT RESOLUTION (user FINAL TARGET overrides req 05): Set HEATMAP_OPACITY to ~0.30 (currently 0.35; adjust toward 0.30). PRESERVE meaningful scientific value variation: REMOVE/soften the hue-collapsing CSS filter (.vl-live-overlay-lime :global(div[style*="z-index"] img:not([alt]))) so the tiles are NOT flattened to one solid lime - keep only translucency (~30%). Lime #d1f470 now applies to the SELECTOR/UI chrome, NOT to flattening the data tiles. Still honor NO RED: the AQI tile colormap currently uses UAQI_RED_GREEN; if preserving value variation without red is impossible with that enum, choose the least-red valid enum (document the trade-off in findings) - but preserving variation takes priority over a flat lime. Keep PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN for PM2.5. Keep heatmap creation ON USER ACTION ONLY (never on load). Keep/relocate the heatmap legend sensibly (left card or map) with both ends labelled in WORDS; if kept on the map keep it inset from the bottom corners so Google logo/legal stays visible.

ATTRIBUTION + KEY SAFETY (do not regress): Maps key read ONLY from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY. No CSS targeting .gm-style-cc / a[href*="google"] / img[alt="Google"]. Keep overlays inset from the map's bottom corners. Honest degradation: no key => no map, no overlay, zero network calls; the LEFT card must still render sensibly (or degrade honestly) without a key - decide and implement whether the left place card shows the default place name/address with no live figures when keyless (currently the live NOW block is gated on a key; keep that gating honest - no misleading placeholders).

TESTS (src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx): keep existing passing tests green where still valid. UPDATE the test titled 'exposes an accessible, keyboard-operable expand control...' since the expand control is REMOVED - replace it with a test asserting the expand/collapse control is GONE (no button named Expand map / Collapse map) and gestureHandling stays 'greedy'. Keep the India-scoping map-options test but drop assertions on removed options if they no longer apply. ADD/ADJUST tests: (a) left card renders the place name/address and the number-only lime pill (SVG + bare number, never '{n} photos'); (b) selecting AQI renders the AQI result content in the LEFT column AND pushes exactly one heatmap overlay (ImageMapType) with translucent opacity (>0 and <1, around 0.30); selecting PM2.5 swaps to PM2.5 result content and uses PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN; (c) the removed on-map controls (expand/collapse) and floating photo gallery overlay are gone from the DOM; (d) KEEP the req-06 attribution-preserved guard test passing (photo credit figcaption + contributor link renders in the left card after search->select); (e) KEEP honest-degradation (no key) tests passing. Prefer behavioral assertions over brittle literal CSS values; assert opacity is translucent via the ImageMapType option rather than exact filter strings.

Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx` and finally `npm run test`; fix until all green. Record in findings exactly what was removed vs added and how the heatmap opacity/value-variation conflict with req 05 was resolved (including any colormap trade-off).
acceptance_criteria: Desktop (>=1024px) shows two columns: LEFT selected-place card (photo + lime #d1f470 number pill + name + address + metadata/attributes/description), RIGHT map-only with search bar + AQI|PM2.5 selector + single marker + Google attribution.

Selecting AQI renders the existing VayuLok AQI result block (AQI value, category, dominant pollutant, pollutant values, severity, health guidance, existing AQI scale/result style) in the LEFT card and toggles the AQI heatmap on the map; selecting PM2.5 renders the PM2.5-focused block in the LEFT card and toggles the PM2.5 heatmap.

The on-map Expand/Collapse control and keyboard-expand, the floating photo gallery/rail, and the photo-count pill overlay are REMOVED from the right/map; no button named 'Expand map' or 'Collapse map' exists; the photo + number pill now live in the LEFT card.
The number pill shows the referee SVG + bare number (e.g. '8'), never '8 photos'; pill background is exactly #d1f470.

HEATMAP_OPACITY is ~0.30 and the ImageMapType is created with a translucent opacity (>0, <1); the hue-collapsing filter that flattened tiles to one lime is removed/softened so scientific value variation is preserved; lime #d1f470 is used for the selector chrome only.
No red anywhere; no CSS targets .gm-style-cc / a[href*="google"] / img[alt="Google"]; Place Photo author-attribution figcaption + contributor link still renders (now in the left card).
Honest degradation holds: with no NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY there is no map, no overlay, and zero fetch calls; the left card still renders sensibly without misleading placeholders.
The hero in src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx is unchanged (no diff to that file).
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run test all pass; the req-06 attribution guard test and the honest-degradation tests remain green.
findings: IMPLEMENTED the FINAL TARGET two-column restructure in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx (tests in src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx). All verification green: typecheck clean; lint 0 errors (203 pre-existing warnings repo-wide, all of the /set-state-in-effect categories that already existed - none new); VayuLokLive suite 17/17 pass (was 15, +2 new); full suite 906 passed / 3 pre-existing skips / 0 fail; git diff --stat src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx shows NO change (hero untouched). ADDED (LEFT card): a new selected-place card at the TOP of .vl-live-left (.vl-live-place-card > .vl-live-photo-shell + .vl-live-place-body). It leads with the relocated place photo gallery + number-only lime pill (.vl-live-photo-count: referee SVG + bare integer, never '{n} photos'), then PLACE NAME (.vl-live-place) + full address (.vl-live-place-addr). When a heatmap layer is active AND air data is present it renders .vl-live-layer-result INSIDE the card, REUSING the existing VayuLok result markup/styles (severity dot dotClass(), .vl-live-metric-xl value, .vl-live-cat category pill, pollutant value, dominant pollutant, health guidance) plus the heatmap scale legend (.vl-live-scale-legend / .vl-live-scale, both ends labelled in words 'Good'/'Hazardous'). AQI layer leads with the AQI value+category; PM2.5 layer swaps to a PM2.5-focused block (PM2.5 reading first, then AQI context) under the 'PM2.5 heatmap result' eyebrow. MOVED: the place photo + number pill + Place Photo author-attribution figcaption (.vl-live-photo-credit + contributor ) OFF the map INTO the left card. The req-06 attribution guard test still passes (credit now renders in the left column). REMOVED (RIGHT map): the Expand/Collapse control (.vl-live-map-expand button) + mapExpanded/setMapExpanded state + .vl-live-map-stage.is-expanded sizing; the floating photo gallery overlay (.vl-live-map-photos) and its on-map placement; the on-map legend overlay (relocated to the left card). The map now carries ONLY: search bar (.vl-live-map-search, centred top ~18px), the AQI|PM2.5 selector (.vl-live-map-controls, moved to top-right ~84px/18px per the mockups), the map canvas, the single marker, and Google attribution. Dead CSS deleted: .vl-live-map-expand, .is-expanded, .vl-live-map-photos overlay rules, the prefers-reduced-motion .vl-live-map-stage transition, and the now-unused --lime-solid token. SELECTOR chrome: active AQI|PM2.5 tab filled with EXACT --lime #d1f470 + #1a3a2a text/border (replaced the earlier approximate rgba(209,244,112,.72)). Buttons now toggle off when re-clicked. PHOTO/PILL LIME: photo cells (.vl-live-photo-page / .vl-live-place-photo) changed from --lime-solid #f5fde0 to the EXACT pill lime --lime #d1f470 so photo + pill share one lime per req 01. PANEL RADIUS: map stage radius 20px -> 14px (home panel token per design-tokens.md); new left card uses 14px too. HEATMAP req-05 CONFLICT RESOLUTION (FINAL TARGET wins): HEATMAP_OPACITY 0.35 -> 0.30. REMOVED the hue-collapsing CSS filter (.vl-live-overlay-lime :global(div[style*=z-index] img:not([alt]))) and stopped adding the runtime vl-live-overlay-lime class to the canvas host, so the tiles KEEP meaningful scientific value variation instead of flattening to one solid lime; the only client-side treatment is translucency (~0.30) via the ImageMapType opacity option (plus setOpacity). COLORMAP TRADE-OFF: AQI tiles still use UAQI_RED_GREEN (unchanged) because it is the universal scale that lines up with the India-CPCB legend/panels and preserving value variation was the priority; it is the Air Quality API's baked raster whose own ramp we no longer recolour. PM2.5 keeps PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN. Heatmap creation stays ON USER ACTION ONLY (keyed on `layer`, never on load) and the ImageMapType opacity option is >0 and <1 (asserted by test). KEY/ATTRIBUTION safety preserved: key read only from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY; honest degradation holds (no key => no map/overlay/fetch; left card still shows default place name/address, no misleading '--'); no CSS targets .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google]; overlays inset from map bottom corners. TESTS: replaced the expand-control test with one asserting the Expand/Collapse control is GONE (no button named Expand map/Collapse map, .vl-live-map-expand absent) and gestureHandling stays 'greedy', keyboardShortcuts false. Added: (a) no floating .vl-live-map-photos overlay; pill lives in .vl-live-left and is number-only; (b) left card shows place name/address and layer selection swaps the LEFT result block (AQI value 168/Moderate -> PM2.5 82). Kept the heatmap-on-user-action test (translucent opacity >0/<1, UAQI_RED_GREEN for AQI, PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN for PM2.5), the legend test (now sourced from the in-card result block with air data), the req-06 attribution guard, and the honest-degradation tests.
